data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flights → hotel → activity → note sequence with the right parameters, but it says "cheapest flight" and "top hotel" where the true workflow uses the first (best) flight and the first hotel scoring 8 or more. It also omits the consent "Reject all" step and the do-not-click constraints, and its note format is vaguer, so an automation would need guesses on several details.
